query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace
MATCH p = (n :Namespace)-[e]->()-[*0..3]->()
WHERE type(e) IN ['Egress', 'EgressDeny']
AND n.displayname = namespace
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Egress (Direct)
description: Direct egress (i.e., no endpoint selectors) for a specific namespace
